description: Self-hosted shared memory, knowledge and code intelligence for AI agents on ClickHouse, served over MCP, HTTP and the Python (clickhouse-loom) and TypeScript (@clickhouse/loom) SDKs.
rules: Every operation is one HTTP endpoint, POST /v1/<operation>, and the same operation is an MCP tool at <server>/mcp.
Every call carries one JWT whose org and namespaces scope what it can read and write.
A memory is one claim stored under a readable key in a namespace; write it with memory.set and find it with memory.search or loom_search.
Use the code.* operations for questions about an indexed repository instead of reading whole files.
